subject: Action required: confirm your seller status
title: Seller status review
preheader: Your sales have passed the EU DSA thresholds for professional selling.
footerNote: Automated message · Please do not reply directly to this email
body:
Hi{{#if firstName}} {{firstName}}{{/if}},

Your selling activity on BidRoom has reached the thresholds that may count as professional selling under the EU Digital Services Act:

{{statsBox}}

Under Article 29 of the DSA, platforms have to ask sellers who pass these thresholds to declare whether they are acting as a trader.

Please confirm your seller status in your dashboard. You have {{graceDays}} days to respond before your account is flagged for review.

If you think this is a mistake, or you have questions, contact support.

This notice is required under Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (Digital Services Act), Article 29.
